story.en: ConnectBook data team meeting. Raj leans back: "Likes and comments live in separate tables. I want one unified activity feed — every interaction, who did it, which post, when. Marketing needs this for the engagement dashboard."
story.ta: ConnectBook data team. Raj saayadhu solla: "Likes-um comments-um separate tables-la irukku. Oru unified activity feed venum." UNION ALL time!
story.hi: ConnectBook data team. Raj: "Likes aur comments alag tables mein hain. Ek unified activity feed chahiye." UNION ALL time!
story.te: ConnectBook data team. Raj: "Likes mariyu comments separate tables lo unnaayi. Oka unified activity feed kavali." UNION ALL time!

question.en: Combine likes and comments into one activity feed. Each row: activity_type (like/comment), user_id, post_id, timestamp. Order by timestamp descending.
question.ta: Likes-um comments-um oru activity feed-aa combine pannu. Prathi row: activity_type, user_id, post_id, timestamp. Timestamp descending.
question.hi: Likes aur comments ko ek activity feed mein combine karo. Har row: activity_type, user_id, post_id, timestamp. Timestamp descending.
question.te: Likes mariyu comments ni oka activity feed ga combine cheyyali. Prathi row: activity_type, user_id, post_id, timestamp. Timestamp descending.

title.en: Query likes with a type label
title.ta: Likes-a type label oda query pannu
title.hi: Likes ko type label ke saath query karo
title.te: Likes ni type label tho query cheyyandi

steps.sql:
SELECT
  'like' AS activity_type,
  user_id, post_id,
  liked_at AS activity_at
FROM likes;

explain.en: The string 'like' AS activity_type hardcodes the word like as a new column for every row. We rename liked_at to activity_at so both queries share the same column names. For UNION ALL both queries must have the same number of columns with compatible types.
explain.ta: 'like' AS activity_type prathi row-ku 'like' nu hardcode panrom. liked_at-a activity_at-aa rename panrom. UNION ALL work aaganum naa rendu queries-lum same column names.
explain.hi: 'like' AS activity_type har row ke liye 'like' hardcode karta hai. liked_at ko activity_at rename kiya. UNION ALL ke liye same column names, same count.
explain.te: 'like' AS activity_type prathi row ki 'like' ani hardcode. liked_at ni activity_at ga rename. UNION ALL work avvadam ki same column names.

title.hi: Comments ke saath UNION ALL karo

steps.sql:
SELECT
  'like' AS activity_type,
  user_id, post_id,
  liked_at AS activity_at
FROM likes

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'comment' AS activity_type,
  user_id, post_id,
  commented_at AS activity_at
FROM comments

ORDER BY activity_at DESC;

explain.en: UNION ALL stacks rows from both queries vertically — no deduplication. ORDER BY at the end sorts the combined result. UNION without ALL removes duplicate rows but is slower. Use UNION ALL when rows are distinct or when duplicates represent meaningful separate events.
explain.ta: UNION ALL rendu queries rows-a vertically stack pannum — duplicate remove illai. End-la ORDER BY combined result sort pannum. UNION (ALL illaamal) duplicates remove pannum aana slow.
explain.hi: UNION ALL dono queries ki rows vertically stack karta hai — deduplication nahi. ORDER BY combined result sort karta hai. UNION bina ALL — duplicates hatata, slow.
explain.te: UNION ALL rendu queries rows ni vertically stack chestundi — deduplication ledi. ORDER BY combined result sort chestundi.

story.en: ConnectBook audit. Raj comes back: "Pipeline bug. Some posts got inserted twice — same user, same content, same timestamp, different post_id. Deduplicate and keep only the row with the lowest post_id in each group."
story.ta: ConnectBook audit. Raj thirumba varandaa: "Pipeline bug. Sila posts rendu thadava insert aagiduchu — same user, content, timestamp, different post_id. Deduplicate panni first post_id mattum vachu venum."
story.hi: ConnectBook audit. Raj wapas aaya: "Pipeline bug. Kuch posts do baar insert ho gaye — same user, content, timestamp, alag post_id. Deduplicate karo, lowest post_id rakho."
story.te: ConnectBook audit. Raj: "Pipeline bug. Kొని posts rendu sarlu insert ayyaayi — same user, content, timestamp, different post_id. Deduplicate chesi modati post_id unchali."

question.en: Identify duplicate posts (same user_id, content, posted_at). Keep only the row with the lowest post_id per group. Return all clean rows.
question.ta: Duplicate posts identify pannu (same user_id, content, posted_at). Lowest post_id irukara row mattum vachu. Ella non-duplicate rows return pannu.
question.hi: Duplicate posts identify karo (same user_id, content, posted_at). Lowest post_id wali row rakho. Sab clean rows return karo.
question.te: Duplicate posts identify cheyyali (same user_id, content, posted_at). Lowest post_id unna row unchali. Anni clean rows return cheyyali.

title.en: Label each row in its group with ROW_NUMBER
title.ta: ROW_NUMBER use panni prathi group-la rows label pannu
title.hi: ROW_NUMBER se har group mein rows label karo
title.te: ROW_NUMBER use chesi prathi group lo rows label cheyyandi

explain.en: ROW_NUMBER() assigns a sequential number within each partition. PARTITION BY user_id, content, posted_at defines what a duplicate group is. ORDER BY post_id gives the lowest post_id a rn of 1. Duplicates get rn=2, rn=3 etc.
explain.ta: ROW_NUMBER() prathi partition-la sequential number vekkuthu. PARTITION BY user_id, content, posted_at nna duplicate group define pannum. Group-la smallest post_id-ku rn=1. Duplicates rn=2, rn=3.
explain.hi: ROW_NUMBER() har partition mein sequential number deta hai. PARTITION BY define karta hai ki duplicate group kya hai. Smallest post_id ko rn=1. Duplicates ko rn=2, rn=3.
explain.te: ROW_NUMBER() prathi partition lo sequential number isthundi. PARTITION BY duplicate group enti ani define chestundi. Smallest post_id ki rn=1. Duplicates ki rn=2, rn=3.

title.en: Filter rn=1 — keep only clean rows
title.ta: rn=1 rows mattum vachu — clean data
title.hi: Sirf rn=1 rows rakho — clean data
title.te: rn=1 rows maatrame unchuko — clean data

steps.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY user_id, content, posted_at
      ORDER BY post_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM posts
)
SELECT post_id, user_id, content, posted_at
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

explain.en: WHERE rn = 1 keeps only the first row from each duplicate group — the one with the smallest post_id. All duplicates (rn > 1) are removed. This ROW_NUMBER + CTE + WHERE rn=1 is the standard SQL deduplication technique. Works in Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, and SQLite.
explain.ta: WHERE rn = 1 prathi duplicate group-la first row mattum varum — smallest post_id irukara row. rn > 1 duplicates filter aagidum. Ee ROW_NUMBER + CTE + WHERE rn=1 standard SQL deduplication pattern. Ella databases-lum work aagidum.
explain.hi: WHERE rn = 1 har group ki pehli row rakhta hai — smallest post_id wali. rn > 1 wale duplicate gone. Yeh standard SQL deduplication technique hai. Sab databases mein kaam karta hai.
explain.te: WHERE rn = 1 prathi group lo modati row — smallest post_id unna row. rn > 1 unna duplicates pothaayi. Ee standard SQL deduplication pattern. Anni databases lo work avutundi.
